summary.result: Model perfomance was very good with relative errors of 10% for comparison of total runoff volume and with one hour delayed peak time.
summary.background: The basic concept of the model is to minimize the error range between forecasted flood inflow and actual flood inflow, and forecast accurately the flood discharge some hours in advance depending on the concentration time(Tc) and soil moisture retention storage(Sa).
summary.method: The flood forecasting model developed was applied to several strom event of Yedang reservoir during past 10 years.
